name: Long-Form Content Burst Builder
description: Workflow for building researched books, guides, long-form HTML, PDFs, or visual reports through a designed index, section-scoped fresh-context agent bursts, image planning, master review, and rebuild loops.

chain.step: Lock the brief, delivery formats, audience, quality bar, research depth, image needs, and acceptance checks.
Research current facts and source/image candidates, then store verified source notes and assets in the research bucket.
Create a designed index with section promises, source needs, visual plan, output paths, and per-section acceptance checks.
Create fresh section packets from the index and source bundle; each packet must be small, self-contained, and scoped to one section.
Spawn bounded section-builder bursts with agent-delegate; each sub-agent receives only its section packet, allowed source paths, output path, and four-step build rubric.
Run master grep/review against the index, section files, citations, image plan, design tokens, and verification report.
Send exact rebuild packets for failed sections and repeat burst review until blockers are cleared.
Assemble the final HTML/PDF suite, run rendered QA, and hand off source paths, artifacts, checks, and residual assumptions.
